tools.name: get_reference
tools.description: Use this when you need today's date in Argentina, the latest draw day, the list of quinielas (the 12 jurisdictions, which turnos each plays) or the turno schedule ('¿a qué hora es la nocturna?', '¿qué quinielas hay?'). Returns reference data only, no results.

tools.name: get_cabezas
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what came out in the Argentine quiniela on a day: '¿qué salió hoy?', 'quiniela de hoy', 'cabezas de ayer', 'resultados de la quiniela', 'quiniela nacional/provincia hoy'. Returns the cabeza (the winning number in position 1) of every jurisdiction and turno for that day; draws not held yet are 'pending'. Pass jurisdiction only when the user names specific quinielas; otherwise the widget shows the five best-known (Ciudad, Provincia, Córdoba, Santa Fe, Entre Ríos). For all 20 numbers of a draw use get_results. When the host shows the result as a widget, the user already sees every number: do not repeat them in a table or list, answer in one or two sentences (what is still pending, or what stands out).

date.description: Draw day in Argentina: YYYY-MM-DD, "today" or "yesterday". Omit for the latest results.

jurisdiction.description: Only these jurisdictions, comma-separated keys or names (e.g. chaco or mendoza,neuquen). Omit for all.

tools.name: get_results
tools.description: Use this when the user wants the full results (the pizarra: 20 numbers) of a quiniela or a turno: 'pizarra de la nocturna', 'los 20 números de la Provincia', 'quiniela de Córdoba vespertina de ayer'. Returns all 20 positions, the cabeza, the draw number and the letters. Filter by jurisdiction (ciudad, provincia, cordoba, santafe, entrerios, montevideo, mendoza, chaco, corrientes, neuquen, jujuy, chubut), by turno (previa (10:15), primera (12:00), matutina (15:00), vespertina (18:00), nocturna (21:00)) or both; at least one is required. When the host shows the result as a widget, the user already sees every number: do not repeat them in a table or list, answer in one or two sentences (what is still pending, or what stands out).

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction key, slug or name, e.g. ciudad, provincia, santa-fe, Córdoba.

turno.description: Turno key: previa, primera, matutina, vespertina or nocturna.

date.description: Draw day in Argentina: YYYY-MM-DD, "today" or "yesterday". Omit for the latest results.

tools.name: check_number
tools.description: Use this when the user asks whether a number came out: '¿salió el 23?', '¿salió el 4512 a la cabeza?', 'controlar quiniela'. Checks a number of 1 to 4 digits (matched by its last digits) against every jurisdiction and turno of a day, a la cabeza or within the first 5, 10 or 20 positions, and lists where it came out. It does not calculate prizes or take bets. When the host shows the result as a widget, the user already sees every number: do not repeat them in a table or list, answer in one or two sentences (what is still pending, or what stands out).

number.description: The number played, 1 to 4 digits, e.g. "23" or "0451".

date.description: Draw day in Argentina: YYYY-MM-DD, "today" or "yesterday". Omit for the latest results.

tools.name: get_number_info
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what a number means in the quiniela or which number a dream corresponds to: '¿qué significa el 48?', 'el 23 en la quiniela', 'soñé con un perro'. Returns the meaning from the traditional quiniela dream table (la quiniela de los sueños) for a number from 00 to 99, plus the latest times it came out a la cabeza. Cultural tradition, not a prediction.

number.description: A number from 00 to 99 (longer numbers use their last two digits).

tools.name: get_statistics
tools.description: Use this when the user asks for the history of past results: 'números más salidos', 'números más atrasados', 'qué número salió más en la Provincia'. Returns how often each ending (00-99) came out a la cabeza, overall and in the last 90 days, and the ones absent the longest. Descriptive history only: draws are random and these figures do not predict anything; never use them to suggest numbers to play.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction key or name; omit for all jurisdictions combined.

tools.name: get_telekino
tools.description: Use this when the user asks about Telekino or Rekino: 'telekino de hoy', 'último sorteo del telekino', 'telekino 2449'. Returns the winning numbers, the winners and prize amounts per hit level, and the winning cartons of the latest sorteo or a given one.

sorteo.description: Sorteo number; omit for the latest.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Quiniela Hoy results with a natural-language query in Spanish or English (e.g. 'quiniela nocturna de ayer', 'Córdoba 2026-10-03', 'qué significa el 23', 'telekino'). Returns document ids to pass to fetch.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Returns the full content of a document id returned by search.

id.description: A document id from search, e.g. cabezas:2026-10-10.
